Name: Makaz
ModernLocation: Disputed; in the Valley of Aijalon, proposed sites include Deir Muheisin and Khirbet el Mukheizin
Description: A town in one of Solomon's supply districts, under Ben-dekar, along with Shaalbim, Beth-shemesh and Elon-beth-hanan in the Valley of Aijalon.
BiblicalSignificance: Makaz is one of the working towns of Solomon's kingdom, named in the roster of districts that fed the royal household.
